title: Hunts FH-016T: Visited-stops map, on-page scan entry and end-to-end player acceptance

source.ref: Split from FH-016S (2026-11-15): the claim action, visited list and hint safety shipped; the map, scan entry and live acceptance remain.

detail: Add the map of visited stops from an authorized source of locations (visited stops only), the camera or scan entry on the player page, and run-version mission binding hardening. Done when: a player completes a Trail end to end from the page against a real database, a second device shows the same revision, and a hidden clue never reaches the page source. Requires: FH-016S, FH-049T. Owner role: Web.
